description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and the Accuracy@1 (%) for two different configurations, labeled “GPT-4o” and an unlabeled method represented by a light purple line with ‘x’ markers. The x-axis, labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width),” ranges from 1 to 7 with integer tick marks at each value. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)”, spans from 15 to 35 with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 5. The “GPT-4o” line (dark blue with circular markers and solid line) starts at 24.4% at tree width 1, rises to 28.9% at width 3, peaks at 34.4% at width 5, then declines to 31.1% at width 7. The second line (light purple with ‘x’ markers and solid line) begins at 26.7% at width 1, increases slightly to 27.8% at width 3, then decreases steadily to 24.4% at width 5 and further to 20.0% at width 7. Both lines are plotted with exact numerical values annotated at each data point.
